## Requirements: Standalone Pages publication acceptance

Pages owns artifact/publication truth; the Acceptance runtime only consumes independently attested evidence, and does not invent the verdict.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01: Define a dedicated strict source-backed Workflow publication receipt with main SHA, Run/Attempt, 27 curated nodes and HTML/JSON hashes read from the actual completed HTTPS deployment.
- [ ] SC-02: Validate receipt at trusted Acceptance boundary using same-run authenticated publisher job and fail-closed tamper/stale/duplicated-log fixtures; publish it as separately typed, issue-scoped evidence (never a direct SC Pass).
- [ ] SC-03: Preserve generic Pages site.json observation and enforce true Workflow Explorer deployment proof in Pages tests, CI and post-merge review.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr

```
